title: Geschwister-Scholl-Straße, Potsdam
description:
Modern Park-side Luxury Terrasse Studio in Villa Ensemble (Potsdam)

Welcome to our modern apartment, ideally situated just across the street from the iconic Schlosspark Sanssouci in Potsdam. Immerse yourself in luxury and comfort in this brand-new, designer-furnished space, part of a newly renovated Villa Ensemble from the Gründerzeit era. Surrounded by lush greenery and a private garden with mature trees, this oasis offers tranquility and relaxation while being conveniently located just 3 minutes away from the nearest train stop, providing easy access to Berlin Alexanderplatz in just 30 minutes. The fully equipped kitchen boasts high-end appliances, including an electric stove, oven, refrigerator, built-in freezer compartment, capsule coffee machine, toaster, and kettle. All necessary utensils for daily use are provided, ensuring a seamless culinary experience. Fresh towels and luxurious bed linen await you for a comfortable stay. Explore the charming neighborhood of Potsdam, with its picturesque streets, historic landmarks, and scenic lakes. Discover the beauty of Schlosspark Sanssouci, a green lung with a rich history dating back centuries. With high-speed internet connection (hidden) Mbps) available throughout the apartment, staying connected has never been easier. Plus, with the University just 5 minutes away, this apartment is tailored to professionals working in the area, offering the perfect blend of convenience and comfort for your stay in Potsdam.

title: Geschwister-Scholl-Straße, Potsdam
description:
The homely furnished apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a beautiful residential building and has a living area of about 40sqm.

The floor in the living and sleeping area consists of beautiful wooden floorboards and the bathroom is tiled. The spacious living room is furnished with a beautiful black leather couch, a matching carpet and a white living room table in front of it. Due to the large windows throughout the apartment, a lot of light falls into the rooms, which creates a cozy atmosphere. In addition, there is a small wardrobe with a mirror and a practical dining table for two people.

In the bedroom, a cozy double bed awaits the two tenants. A spacious closet on the wall next to it provides ample storage space.

The kitchen is part of the living room and leaves nothing to be desired: a refrigerator, a modern stove with oven, a coffee maker, a toaster, a kettle, as well as dishes and cutlery are ready for you.

The bathroom is well-equipped and comes with a shower, a toilet, mirror as well as a sink. In addition, towels are ready for the tenant.

The apartment is located in the center of Potsdam. To the popular Charlottenhof Palace and the adjacent park of the same name, it is only 500 walking meters and thus less than 6 min. Behind it stretches a wide green space, which invites you to relax. Since the apartment is very centrally located in Potsdam, the connection to the public transport network is ideal. 2 min from the front door is a bus and streetcar stop, from which all other destinations can be reached easily. Even to the "Potsdam Charlottenhof" train station, from which regional trains can also be accessed, it is only a 5 min walk. Supermarkets are also not far: A Lidl is reached in six min and a REWE in eleven min.

- The registration fee is 65€ per person during the week Mon-Fri 10am-5pm and 100€ per person outside opening hours (Mon-Fri 10am-5pm) or on weekends.

The following items are available for purchase for personal use:
- bathing essentials 70€ including: 
* hand & bath towel 
You are welcome to express this wish when registering.


You are welcome to express your wish after the conclusion of the contract or in good time before registering by e-mail, so that we can provide the required items in advance for check-in.

title: Lindenstraße, Potsdam
description:
DEUTSCH:
Diese schöne Erdgeschosswohnung befindet sich in einem repräsentativen Mehrfamilienhaus in der historischen Innenstadt von Potsdam. Dieses neuwertige 1-Zimmer-Appartement mit einer Wohnfläche von insgesamt 43,89 m2 befindet sich im Erdgeschoss und verfügt hofseitig über eine Sondernutzungsfläche als Terrasse von ca. 5 m2, welche nach Osten hin ausgerichtet ist. Ein Kellerabteil mit ca. 5 m2 im Nachbargebäude gehört ebenso dazu. Im Hof gibt es zudem einen Fahrradabstellraum für die Bewohner.
Die Wohnung wird als möblierte Wohnung auf Zeit vermietet (9-36 Monate).. Das Inventar (Möbel und komplett eingereichte Einbauküche nebst Sitzmöglichkeiten) ist und bleibt Eigentum des Vermieters.

Der Grundriss der Wohnung ist praktisch. Über einen Flur erreicht man Küche, Bad und das kombinierte Wohn- & Schlafzimmer. Das Bad mit Fenster ist hell gefliest und verfügt über eine Dusche sowie eine Waschmaschine. Die Küche ist rechteckig geschnitten und mit einem bodentiefen Fenster zur Terrasse versehen, Das Wohnzimmer mit seinen ca. 18m2 ist modern eingerichtet und lichtdurchflutet. Der Zustand ist neuwertig. Ein PKW-Stellplatz steht hier leider nicht zur Verfügung, jedoch verfügen die umliegenden Straßen über
zahlreiche Parkmöglichkeiten und Anwohnerparkausweise können bei der Stadt Potsdam beantragt werden.

Man stolpert aus der Wohnung direkt in die lebhafte Innenstadt mit großen Fußgängerzonen, gut besuchten Restaurants, charmanten Cafés und vielen Geschäften bekannter Marken. Im naheliegenden historischen Holländischen Viertel stehen Giebelhäuser im Amsterdamer Stil mit bunten Fensterläden und Vorgärten. Ganz in der Nähe befinden sich die prächtigen, aus preußischer Zeit stammenden Gebäude der Potsdamer Universität, das Filmmuseum und das Museum Barberini.

ENGLISH:
This beautiful ground floor apartment (43.89 m2) is located in the historic city center of Potsdam. The apartment is rented out only temporary (9-36 months) and is fully furnished. The inventory (furniture and fully furnished fitted kitchen along with seating) is the property of the landlord. The bathroom with window is brightly tiled and has a shower and washing machine. The kitchen is rectangular in shape and has a floor-to-ceiling window facing the terrace. The living room with its approx. 18m2 is modernly furnished and flooded with light. The furniture is new.. Unfortunately there is no parking space available.

From this apartment you are literally stumbling straight into the lively city center with large pedestrian zones, busy restaurants, charming cafés and many well-known brand shops. In the nearby historic Dutch Quarter there are Amsterdam-style gabled houses with colorful shutters and front gardens. Nearby are the magnificent Prussian-era buildings of the University of Potsdam, the Film Museum and the Barberini Museum.

title: Geschwister-Scholl-Straße, Potsdam
description:
Welcome to your fully furnished retreat in Potsdam! This elegant 2-room apartment on the 2nd floor of a modern new development offers approx. 53 sqm of living space and a spacious 9.5 sqm balcony – with stunning views of Sanssouci Palace Park.

The open-plan living and dining area features a designer sofa, a round dining table for four, and a dedicated workspace with desk – ideal for remote work. Large windows flood the space with natural light and lead directly to the sunny balcony, perfect for relaxing outdoors in a peaceful green setting.

The sleek kitchen is fully equipped with an induction cooktop, dishwasher, microwave, Nespresso machine, and a washer-dryer combo. All necessary kitchenware and tableware are included.

The bedroom includes a comfortable box-spring bed (160 × 200 cm), two bedside tables and floor-to-ceiling windows with tranquil views. A separate walk-in wardrobe offers generous storage space.

The bathroom features a clean, contemporary design with a walk-in rain shower, illuminated mirror, and premium fittings.

Key features:

- Approx. 53 sqm of living space with a 9.5 sqm balcony overlooking Sanssouci Palace Park
- Real wood flooring and modern designer furnishings throughout
- Open-plan living area with sofa, TV, and dedicated workspace
- Bedroom with box-spring bed (160 × 200 cm)
- Separate dressing area with large built-in wardrobe
- Stylish bathroom with walk-in rain shower and illuminated mirror
- Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, washer, and Nespresso machine
- Quiet setting directly adjacent to Sanssouci Park
- Public transport as well as the University of Potsdam within walking distance

Berlin reachable in approx. 30 minutes by train

Additional Information
Please note that the apartment is part of a newly developed residential complex where final landscaping is still in progress. As a result, some daytime construction noise may occur, and the garden area is not yet accessible. In consideration of this, we are offering the apartment at a special introductory rate of €1,790.00 per month.

SPECIAL RATES FOR LONG-TERM STAY:
- if you book at least 6 consecutive months, you will receive a discount of 12% on the rent
- if you book 12 consecutive months, you will receive a discount of 18% on the rent (longer periods available upon request)
